title: Lottie
summary: Small vector accents in the theme look: marker marks, stamps, tape, torn paper and ink, drawn on in held steps and then boiling between three wobbling redraws. Generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs.

items.name: Scribble circle
items.description: A marker circle drawn one and a half times round, then a thinner second pass; both keep boiling.

items.name: Scribble underline
items.description: A red underline scrawled back and forth under two grey word bars.

items.name: Arrow scrawl
items.description: A wandering marker arrow draws itself to a point and lands a red dot.

items.name: Cross out
items.description: Two fat red slashes struck on in a few frames each, with a shake on every hit.

items.name: Check scrawl
items.description: A rough hand-drawn box, then a lime tick thrown through it.

items.name: Burst star
items.description: A spiky hand-drawn burst pops on around a red blot and boils, with a few flicked ticks.

items.name: Question scrawl
items.description: A fat marker question mark draws on, its red dot slams down, a thin loop circles it.

items.name: Asterisk boil
items.description: A worn red asterisk turning in held steps while its strokes boil: loading, thinking, hold on. Loops.

items.name: Pen test
items.description: A pen-test zigzag drawn across behind a red nib, then eaten away from the start. Loops.

items.name: Tally count
items.description: Four tally strokes drawn one at a time, then a red slash through them: five.

items.name: Target scribble
items.description: A spiral scribbled inward to its centre, marked with a red cross.

items.name: Stamp hit
items.description: A round red rubber stamp slams down from oversized, shakes, and leaves a worn print with a faint double.

items.name: Tape slap
items.description: A torn scrap of paper jumps in and a strip of masking tape slaps down over its top edge.

items.name: Ink splat
items.description: A red ink blot bursts open, throws droplets and runs three drips.

items.name: Highlight stroke
items.description: A lime highlighter dragged in steps through the middle of three lines.

items.name: Torn strip wipe
items.description: A torn bone-paper strip steps in from the right and a red strip from the left, each with ragged edges.
